kagawongExceptions: No exception names Lake Kagawong itself, BUT the zone's waterbody-exceptions table has a 'Manitoulin Island - inland waters including Cockburn Island' entry that APPLIES to Lake Kagawong and overrides zone-wide rules for 4 species: (1) Lake trout: open Jan 1 to Sep 30, S-2 and C-1, NO size limit (zone-wide is Jan 1 to Labour Day with a size restriction); (2) Northern pike: open Jan 1 to Mar 31 and 3rd Sat in May to Dec 31 (zone-wide is open all year); (3) Rainbow trout: open 4th Sat in April to Dec 31 (zone-wide is open all year); (4) Yellow perch: open Jan 1 to Mar 31 and 3rd Sat in May to Dec 31, Sport daily 25/possession 50, Conservation daily 12/possession 25 (zone-wide is open all year, S-50/C-25). Also relevant: FISH SANCTUARY on the Kagawong River (Billings Township, Hwy 540 bridge downstream to Henry St bridge in the Village of Kagawong) - NO FISHING Sep 25 to Oct 31. Manitoulin Island is EXCLUDED from the Northeast Bait Management Zone. The 'waters north of Hwy 17 open year-round for bass' rule does NOT apply (Manitoulin is south of Hwy 17). All lakes on Manitoulin are Zone 10 except South Bay (Zone 13) and Lake Wolsey (Zone 14).
note: The season/sport/conservation/sizeLimits fields below are the values AS THEY APPLY TO LAKE KAGAWONG (i.e. with the Manitoulin Island inland-waters exception applied). Where the exception differs from the zone-wide rule, the zone-wide value is preserved in zoneWide* fields. Aggregate limit for all trout and salmon combined (incl. splake): Sport 5, Conservation 2 - the total daily catch and possession for all trout/salmon species together.
